intro: A spa, a vitamin store, a sanctuary shop and a naturopathic practice all offer scan sessions in Alabama, and the AO Scan is the device that links most of them. This page covers bioresonance practitioners in Foley, Birmingham and Vestavia Hills, Decatur and Killen. Five practices share it, with 164 reviews between them at an average of 4.9.

Foley has two. Be Balanced Spa is a women owned spa offering an AO Scan along with massage, Reiki, sound baths, Bemer sessions and ionic foot baths, and a doctor of acupuncture and a holistic life coach are part of the team. It is rated 4.8 from 65 reviews. Quantum Energy Healing LLC, run by Chelsea Burns, offers scan sessions with the AO Scan and the Equiscope for animals. Chelsea describes the AO Scan as an educational wellness tool that gives frequency-based feedback, used for people, dogs and horses alike, and the practice is rated 5.0 from 2 reviews.

Doc Bodie Cares is a naturopathic wellness practice led by Dr. Stefanie Bodie, ND, serving Vestavia Hills and Birmingham and working virtually across the United States and internationally. Services include Emotion Code, personalised wellness programs, supplement recommendations and AO Scan sessions with Inner Voice scans. It is rated 5.0 from 40 reviews.

In Killen, Shoals Healing Frequencies is a metaphysical and holistic shop and sanctuary built around sound, light and frequency. April offers biofeedback scans and AO Scan sessions alongside massage, Reiki and intuitive readings, for people and for pets. Sessions run 60 minutes in person or remotely over Zoom, with booking through Vagaro. It is rated 5.0 from 21 reviews.

The ZYTO scanner turns up in an unexpected place. Gloria's Good Health in Decatur has been a locally owned vitamin, supplement and health food store since 1989, and alongside supplements and natural foods it offers vibration platform sessions, an infrared sauna and a ZYTO scanner. It has curbside pickup and delivery, and is rated 4.6 from 36 reviews. Anyone planning a ZYTO session there can ask in store how long a scan takes, what the follow up looks like and whether booking ahead is needed.

Remote sessions and sessions for animals both appear at two practices, so the choices extend beyond a visit to a studio. Neighbouring pages cover Georgia, Tennessee, Louisiana, South Carolina and Kentucky.

faqs.q: Where can I find an AO Scan session in Alabama?
faqs.a: AO Scan sessions are offered by Be Balanced Spa and Quantum Energy Healing LLC in Foley, by Doc Bodie Cares in Vestavia Hills and Birmingham, and by Shoals Healing Frequencies in Killen. Be Balanced Spa is rated 4.8 from 65 reviews and Doc Bodie Cares 5.0 from 40.

faqs.q: Which Alabama practitioners work remotely?
faqs.a: Doc Bodie Cares works virtually across the United States and internationally, and Shoals Healing Frequencies offers 60 minute sessions over Zoom as well as in person. Doc Bodie Cares is led by Dr. Stefanie Bodie, ND.

faqs.q: Can pets have sessions in Alabama?
faqs.a: Shoals Healing Frequencies in Killen offers biofeedback scans and AO Scan sessions for pets as well as people, and Quantum Energy Healing LLC in Foley uses the Equiscope for animals, for dogs and horses alongside people. Ratings are 5.0 from 21 reviews and 5.0 from 2.

faqs.q: Who offers a ZYTO scanner in Alabama?
faqs.a: Gloria's Good Health in Decatur, a vitamin and health food store open since 1989, has a ZYTO scanner and is rated 4.6 from 36 reviews. Call ahead to ask how a session is booked.

faqs.q: Which pages sit next to Alabama?
faqs.a: Georgia, Tennessee, Louisiana, South Carolina and Kentucky each have their own page. They help anyone near the state line who is happy to travel.

intro: Alberta's bioresonance practitioners work from Calgary, Edmonton, Sherwood Park, Beaumont, Red Deer and Bow Island. This page holds eight practices, and the combined reviews come to 79 with an average of 5.0. Calgary has the longest review histories, while elsewhere in the province practices have a single review or none yet.

Calgary carries the most reviewed names. Integrative Health Centre in southwest Calgary is led by Dr Chantelle Drobot, ND, and combines naturopathic care with chiropractic, Chinese medicine, acupuncture and massage. A ZYTO scan is among its services alongside personalised supplement plans, and new appointments can be booked online. It is rated 4.9 from 63 reviews. Cheryle Cote Holistic Healing has worked in Calgary for 40 years across hypnotherapy, Reiki, tuning forks and BodyTalk, and offers quantum bioresonance biofeedback and bioresonance sound sessions. It is rated 4.9 from 12 reviews.

The Edmonton area follows. The Optimal Health & Wellness Program in Edmonton offers NES Health bio-energetic scanning with life and wellness coaching, rated 5.0 from 1 review. Blue Iris Healthcare Inc. in Sherwood Park is run by a herbalist who is also a bioresonance therapist, offering energy work, nutritional counselling and health coaching, rated 5.0 from 1 review. Wellness Concepts Ltd - Rife Frequency Healing in Beaumont is a women-owned practice working with Rife and resonant frequencies, serving the Edmonton area and central Alberta.

Mokelky Health & MediSpa in Red Deer is a family-run wellness center offering bioresonance sessions with BEMER PEMF mat sessions, red light and health coaching. Mat sessions run 10 to 40 minutes and are described as suitable for people or pets, and remote services are arranged by email. Buffaloberry Bioresonance in Bow Island works with a Rayonex device. Its electroids carry signals to the machine, a method that goes back to the work of Paul Schmitt.

The devices named on this page are ZYTO, NES Health and Rayonex, one practice each. Red Deer is where remote sessions and sessions for pets are named. The practices differ in type: a naturopathic clinic, a hypnotherapy and energy practice, a herbalist, a frequency practice and a wellness spa.

Because most of the single-review ratings are 5.0, a rating alone says little, and the review count is the better guide to how much history a practice has. Phoning ahead to ask which device is used and how a first session works is the simplest way to compare the smaller practices. Alberta's neighbouring pages are Saskatchewan, British Columbia, Manitoba, Ontario and Quebec.

faqs.q: Where in Alberta can I find a ZYTO scan?
faqs.a: Integrative Health Centre in southwest Calgary offers a ZYTO scan with personalised supplement plans, within a clinic that also covers naturopathic care, chiropractic, acupuncture and massage. It is led by Dr Chantelle Drobot, ND, and rated 4.9 from 63 reviews. Online booking is open.

faqs.q: Which Alberta practitioners use NES Health or Rayonex?
faqs.a: The Optimal Health & Wellness Program in Edmonton offers NES Health bio-energetic scanning, and Buffaloberry Bioresonance in Bow Island uses a Rayonex device. The first is rated 5.0 from 1 review, and the second has yet to collect reviews.

faqs.q: Does anyone in Alberta offer sessions for pets?
faqs.a: Mokelky Health & MediSpa in Red Deer describes its PEMF mat sessions as suitable for people or pets, and offers remote services arranged by email. It is a family-run wellness center rated 5.0 from 1 review.

faqs.q: Who works in the Edmonton area and central Alberta?
faqs.a: Wellness Concepts Ltd - Rife Frequency Healing in Beaumont serves the Edmonton area and central Alberta, using Rife and resonant frequencies. The Optimal Health & Wellness Program is in Edmonton itself, and Blue Iris Healthcare Inc. is in Sherwood Park.

faqs.q: Which pages sit next to Alberta?
faqs.a: Saskatchewan, British Columbia, Manitoba, Ontario and Quebec each have a page. They are worth a look for anyone near the provincial border who is willing to travel for a session.

intro: Arizona's bioresonance practitioners work from nine towns across the state rather than from one metro area. Nine practices are shown: Scottsdale, Mesa and Fountain Hills, then Tucson, Prescott, Flagstaff, Yuma and Buckeye.

Scottsdale has two of them. Quasar Quantum Healing, rated 5.0 from 63 reviews, is a wellness center that offers the Comprehensive AO Scan with its Digital Body Analyzer, and the same site has a Himalayan salt cave, a hyperbaric chamber and yoga classes. It works by appointment only, and a free first consultation is available. Angel of Hearts Wellness, also in Scottsdale, offers ZYTO Evox biofeedback sessions built around perception reframing and balance, and has yet to collect reviews. Fountain Hills sits just to the east, where Modern Wellness offers biofeedback, bioenergetic and bioresonance sessions as custom wellness screenings, rated 5.0 from 3 reviews.

Devices are a mix here, described in words rather than counted. ZYTO is the device named most often: Ray Chiropractic Center, PLLC in Mesa has recently added a ZYTO scan to a chiropractic practice, and Mountain Air Chiropractic in Prescott offers ZYTO scans alongside PEMF, cold laser and muscle testing. The AO Scan, with its voice-based sessions, shows up in Scottsdale, Yuma and Buckeye. Blessed Balance and Love in Yuma offers AO Scan voice sessions in Spanish, with auriculotherapy, Access Bars and Bach flowers on the same menu, and is rated 5.0 from 10 reviews. Healing Moon in Buckeye pairs AO Scan sessions with Reiki, energy work and handmade crystal jewelry, by appointment arranged through text.

Tucson and Flagstaff each have a practice of their own. In Tucson, LS Quantum Biofeedback offers Quantum Biofeedback LIFE System sessions, either in person or over Zoom, with a recording and notes sent after a distance session. It is rated 5.0 from 15 reviews. In Flagstaff, The Wellness Initiative is led by a Doctor of Natural Medicine and offers full body bioresonance scans next to auriculotherapy with ear seeds, fitness and nutrition guidance and mindfulness practices. Clients there start with a comprehensive wellness assessment.

The kinds of practice are broad. Two are chiropractic offices, one is a Spanish language holistic practice, one is a spa style wellness center, one is a reflexology and energy studio, and the rest are naturopathic or coaching led. The remote option in Tucson reaches clients wherever they live in the state.

Reviews are strong across the page, with the combined total at 120 and an average of 4.9. Two practices have yet to collect their first reviews. Neighbouring state pages cover Nevada, New Mexico, Utah, California and Colorado, which suits anyone near the state line, for example around Yuma, who might be comparing practitioners across the border.

faqs.q: Which Arizona practitioners offer ZYTO scan sessions?
faqs.a: ZYTO sessions are offered by Ray Chiropractic Center, PLLC in Mesa, Mountain Air Chiropractic in Prescott and Angel of Hearts Wellness in Scottsdale. Angel of Hearts focuses on ZYTO Evox biofeedback sessions, while the two chiropractic offices add ZYTO to wider practices that include nutrition, cold laser and PEMF.

faqs.q: Is there anyone in Arizona who offers sessions at a distance?
faqs.a: LS Quantum Biofeedback in Tucson offers Quantum Biofeedback LIFE System sessions over Zoom as well as in person. A distance session comes with a recording, personalised notes and educational materials, and the client only needs a quiet place to relax. It is rated 5.0 from 15 reviews.

faqs.q: Where in Arizona can I find an AO Scan session?
faqs.a: AO Scan sessions are offered in Scottsdale at Quasar Quantum Healing, in Yuma at Blessed Balance and Love, which runs sessions in Spanish, and in Buckeye at Healing Moon. Quasar is rated 5.0 from 63 reviews and Blessed Balance and Love 5.0 from 10.

faqs.q: Which Arizona towns have a practitioner outside Scottsdale and Mesa?
faqs.a: Yes. Tucson has LS Quantum Biofeedback, Prescott has Mountain Air Chiropractic, Flagstaff has The Wellness Initiative and Yuma has Blessed Balance and Love. Each works from its own town, so the page spans the state rather than one metro area.

faqs.q: Which nearby state pages can I look at from Arizona?
faqs.a: The pages next to Arizona cover Nevada, New Mexico, Utah, California and Colorado. They are useful for anyone living near a state line who is willing to travel, or who wants to compare the kinds of practices and devices offered across the border.

intro: Auckland is a place where bioresonance practitioners are as likely to meet clients on a screen as in a room. Of the nine practices on this page, five offer remote sessions, and the rest are spread across the city, Grey Lynn, Orewa to the north, Pukekohe and Bombay to the south, and the Whangaparaoa coast. This page covers bioresonance practitioners in and around Auckland, with a neighbouring page for Canterbury.

The devices named here are varied. BioEnergetix, run by Chantelle French and rated 5.0 from 11 reviews, uses the NES Health Energy4Life scan together with the Genius Insight Voice Scan, and offers both in person and remote sessions. SoulfulSync Holistic Studio in Orewa, also rated 5.0 from 11 reviews, is run by Eva, who holds a Diploma in Quantum Biofeedback, and uses the Scio device. A 45 minute Reset is offered in person in Auckland or remotely, and a longer 90 minute Deep Reset goes further.

Naturopathy and homeopathy are a recurring thread. Inbalance Naturopathy & Body Therapy in Grey Lynn combines naturopathic consultation with bioresonance, iridology and Reiki, and an AO Scan Inner Voice scan creates personalised audio files. It also arranges remote sessions for clients elsewhere, and for dogs, cats and horses, from basic information about the animal. It is rated 5.0 from 5 reviews. Native Herbs LTD is an Auckland homeopath practice with a shop for herbal and homeopathic products made in New Zealand, and its services menu includes bio-resonance analysis.

South of the city, Kat's Natural Solutions is a naturopathy practice based in Pukekohe and Bombay that also supports clients online. It combines nutrition and lifestyle guidance with a Functional Health Screening that uses bioresonance as a non-invasive scan. A free 15 minute discovery call is open to new clients. It is rated 5.0 from 2 reviews.

Two entries sit under the name Bioresonance Therapy Clinic, each rated 5.0 from 1 review. One is run by Caroll Macy in Auckland and walks new clients through a set sequence from initial assessment to a series of sessions. The other offers FCT bioresonance sessions and online consultations, and is entered under Whangaparaoa while stating a move to Bethlehem, Tauranga, so anyone interested should confirm the address and service area by phone before planning a visit.

Together the page holds a total of 37 reviews with an average of 4.9. Ratings are high, but several practices have only a handful of reviews behind them, so the count matters as much as the number. Remote sessions are easy to find across the page, which suits clients outside the city or those who prefer a session from home.

faqs.q: Who offers remote bioresonance sessions around Auckland?
faqs.a: BioEnergetix, SoulfulSync Holistic Studio, Inbalance Naturopathy & Body Therapy, Kat's Natural Solutions and a Bioresonance Therapy Clinic entry all offer remote or online sessions. BioEnergetix works with both in person and remote clients, and Inbalance also arranges remote sessions for pets.

faqs.q: Which Auckland practitioners work with animals?
faqs.a: Inbalance Naturopathy & Body Therapy in Grey Lynn arranges remote bioresonance sessions for dogs, cats and horses, using basic information about the animal. It is the practice on the Auckland page that names animal sessions, and it is rated 5.0 from 5 reviews.

faqs.q: Is there a practitioner north of the city centre?
faqs.a: SoulfulSync Holistic Studio is in Orewa, north of Auckland. Run by Eva, it offers Scio quantum frequency biofeedback sessions, with Bioptron light and singing bowl sessions alongside. It holds a 5.0 rating from 11 reviews, and sessions are also available in Auckland or remotely.

faqs.q: Does anyone in Auckland offer a free first conversation?
faqs.a: Kat's Natural Solutions in Pukekohe and Bombay offers a free 15 minute discovery call to new clients before any session is booked. The practice combines holistic nutrition and lifestyle guidance with a bioresonance scan, and it supports clients online as well.

faqs.q: Which nearby page covers practitioners outside Auckland?
faqs.a: Canterbury is the neighbouring page and has its own practitioners. Several of the Auckland practices also work remotely, so distance from the city does not have to limit the choice for clients elsewhere in the country.

intro: British Columbia spreads its bioresonance practitioners across Surrey, Burnaby, Langley, Vernon, Penticton, Creston, Winlaw, Sorrento, Harrison Hot Springs, Victoria, Qualicum Beach and Port Alberni. 13 practitioners are listed for the province, and the bioresonance practitioners here often describe themselves in terms of a wider wellness background, from nutrition to massage to skin care.

Nutrition is a clear thread in the Lower Mainland. Eating to Live Well Inc. is the Surrey practice of Valerie Mrakuzic, a Registered Holistic Nutritionist and Quantum Biofeedback Specialist, who offers a biofeedback scan with a nutritional report along with wellness and nutrition programs and a free first consultation. Integrative Medical Wellness IMW, also in Surrey, is a women-owned wellness clinic and natural health store with massage, wellness coaching, energy work and Qest4 bioenergetic sessions. In Burnaby, Dr. Peter Liu, ND is a licensed naturopathic doctor who speaks English and Mandarin and includes a biofeedback scan among nutrition, homeopathy and herbal services.

Outside Surrey and Burnaby, the setting changes. Enhance Studio Medi & Wellness Spa Ltd has served Vernon since 1986 and combines quantum and neuro biofeedback with colour, sound and skin care studio services. Biofeedback Treatment in Okanagan is a Penticton practice led by Charlene Reeves, who teaches holistic food principles and works with ZYTO, Indigo and SCIO systems. Magic Fingers Clinic, founded in 1997 by Christine Labrot, has moved to Creston and offers therapeutic massage, postural work with the Egoscue Method, a Life Expert 3.0 body scan and Energy Enhancement System sessions. Qwest 4 Health in Harrison Hot Springs is run by Dr. Diane Blackburn (DNM) and John, with an initial consultation that combines iridology and quantum biofeedback.

Devices are named across the page. Rayonex is the system at Allergy Elimination Centre Shuswap in Sorrento, where sensors are placed on the wrists and ankles. NES BioEnergetiX, with the miHealth device, is the core of Quantum Energy Healing, the Victoria practice of Wolfgang Zilker, who also offers an online bioenergy scan for clients at a distance. Omnipotent Health in Qualicum Beach, the practice of Lou Walkden, offers Solex AO Scan sessions in person or by Zoom. Sun Synergy Studio in Langley offers bioresonance sessions and Holographic Kinetics, and runs an online shop for bioresonance devices.

Remote and animal sessions exist but are not the norm. Magic Fingers Clinic, Quantum Energy Healing and Omnipotent Health all work at a distance. Biofeedback Treatment in Okanagan and Omnipotent Health also offer sessions for animals. Quantum Energy Healing and Eating to Live Well Inc. offer a free first consultation. Roselman Bioresonance in Port Alberni is a wellness center with bioresonance in its name.

For review history, Eating to Live Well Inc. has 4.7 from 39 reviews and Enhance Studio Medi & Wellness Spa Ltd has 4.6 from 31. Integrative Medical Wellness IMW has 5.0 from 24, and Magic Fingers Clinic has 4.9 from 23. Sun Synergy Studio has 5.0 from 7, and several others are rated 5.0 from 4 reviews or fewer.
Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario and Quebec have their own pages on this directory.

faqs.q: Which British Columbia practitioners use SCIO or ZYTO?
faqs.a: Enhance Studio Medi & Wellness Spa Ltd in Vernon works with SCIO. Biofeedback Treatment in Okanagan in Penticton names ZYTO, Indigo and SCIO among the many biofeedback systems it uses, led by Charlene Reeves.

faqs.q: Who offers remote bioenergy scans from British Columbia?
faqs.a: Quantum Energy Healing in Victoria, the practice of Wolfgang Zilker, offers an online bioenergy scan with subconscious coaching for clients at a distance. Magic Fingers Clinic in Creston and Omnipotent Health in Qualicum Beach also work remotely, the latter by Zoom.

faqs.q: Is there a licensed naturopathic doctor who offers a scan on this page?
faqs.a: Dr. Peter Liu, ND is a licensed naturopathic doctor in Burnaby who speaks English and Mandarin. His services include a biofeedback scan alongside nutrition, homeopathy and herbal medicine, and he offers Theralase cool laser sessions.

faqs.q: Which Victoria-area and island towns have a practice?
faqs.a: Quantum Energy Healing is in Victoria, Omnipotent Health in Qualicum Beach and Roselman Bioresonance in Port Alberni. Omnipotent Health also offers sessions for animals and works remotely.

faqs.q: Who offers a skin care studio alongside biofeedback?
faqs.a: Enhance Studio Medi & Wellness Spa Ltd in Vernon pairs quantum and neuro biofeedback, colour and sound sessions with skin services such as microdermabrasion and carbon laser facials, and has served Vernon since 1986.

intro: California's page carries 41 bioresonance practitioners, and they are spread through the state rather than packed into one metro area. Stockton, Placerville, Yorba Linda, Fair Oaks, Citrus Heights, Fresno, Los Osos, Santa Maria, Encinitas, Redding and Beverly Hills each have at least one practice offering wellness scan sessions. Someone searching here is choosing between a practice in their own town and one a drive away, and the remote sessions covered below widen that choice.

A good share of the practices sit inside skin care and spa studios. Pure Holistic Skin Care in Placerville is an organic skin care studio with full body waxing, run by a certified bio resonance practitioner, and it is rated 4.9 from 33 reviews. NU Sugaring & Wellness in Yorba Linda pairs sugaring, waxing and lash tinting with Qest4 sessions and online booking, rated 5.0 from 29 reviews. In Stockton, HFS Trichology & Head Spa Inc. runs head spa and scalp care sessions next to a ZYTO wellness scan, and its 5.0 from 72 reviews is the largest review history among the practices in this region. SKIN AND BEYOND in Fair Oaks is a massage and skin care studio that adds biofeedback and bioresonance sessions to facials, cupping and Reiki, rated 5.0 from 20 reviews.

Massage therapists and bodyworkers make up the second group. Essentials 2 Wellness in Kingsburg combines Swedish massage, reflexology and cranial sacral work with ZYTO biofeedback and NES bio-energetics. Metamorphosis Health & Massage Therapy in Redding is led by a massage practitioner with twenty-five years in the field and guides its consultations with the ZYTO Body Scan. Mind, Body, and Sole Wellness in Citrus Heights offers bioresonance body scanning beside foot zoning and foot bath spa sessions, and it teaches clients the foot zone technique as it goes.

Coaches and hypnotherapists form a third group, and their sessions lean toward stress, balance and personal development. Beyond Wholeness in Encinitas is led by a facilitator and coach who brings quantum biofeedback into work on life transitions and relationships. Atrévete Al Cambio Integral Wellness Center in Santa Maria offers personal coaching, workshops and fitness and nutrition advice in English and Spanish, with a ZYTO scanner on the service list. Quantum Waves Hypnotherapy & Biofeedback in Los Osos pairs hypnotherapy with SCIO sessions, and Christel Clear in Hercules combines Qest4 sessions with coaching, bodywork and energy work.

The devices follow the practitioners. ZYTO is the most familiar name in the northern and central towns, found in Stockton, Kingsburg, Redding, Santa Maria and Pleasant Hill, where the Holistic Center For Natural Healing offers a ZYTO biofeedback scan and a hair scan mapping session. Healtheee-U in Carson is an herb shop that offers ZYTO balance scanning and iridology readings, rated 4.4 from 11 reviews. Qest4 sessions turn up in Yorba Linda, Hercules and Loomis, where Gold Country Wellness works with Qest4 and offers sessions for pets. SCIO and Eductor sessions are offered in Los Osos, Encinitas and Beverly Hills, where Quantum Biofeedback Inc. uses an Eductor SCIO device and is rated 4.6 from 7 reviews. NES Health scans appear in Kingsburg and in Antioch, at Juneva Health.

Remote sessions matter in a state this long. Illuminate Vitality in Fresno, Gold Country Wellness in Loomis, Juneva Health in Antioch and Quantum Biofeedback Inc. in Beverly Hills all offer sessions at a distance, so a reader far from the nearest practice is not shut out. Animals are covered too: SportsIQ in Westlake Village uses a scanning system built for dogs, cats and horses and also combines bioresonance with nutrition and fitness coaching.

Practices on this page that serve a different state are listed on the neighbouring pages for Nevada, Arizona, Oregon, Utah and Idaho. Many California practices are new to the page and carry only a handful of reviews, so the rating and the review count are worth reading side by side before booking, and the listing cards below carry the details each practice offers.

faqs.q: Which California practices offer ZYTO scan sessions?
faqs.a: ZYTO is offered by a mix of practice types. HFS Trichology & Head Spa Inc. in Stockton, Essentials 2 Wellness in Kingsburg, Metamorphosis Health & Massage Therapy in Redding and Atrévete Al Cambio Integral Wellness Center in Santa Maria all list it. Healtheee-U, an herb shop in Carson, offers ZYTO balance scanning too.

faqs.q: Can I book a scan session remotely from California?
faqs.a: Yes, several practices offer remote sessions. Illuminate Vitality in Fresno, Gold Country Wellness in Loomis, Juneva Health in Antioch and Quantum Biofeedback Inc. in Beverly Hills describe sessions at a distance. Check each listing card for how a remote booking works.

faqs.q: Where in California can I find skin care studios that also offer bioresonance sessions?
faqs.a: Pure Holistic Skin Care in Placerville, NU Sugaring & Wellness in Yorba Linda, SKIN AND BEYOND in Fair Oaks and HFS Trichology & Head Spa Inc. in Stockton each combine skin or scalp services with wellness scan sessions.

faqs.q: Does any California practice offer scan sessions for pets or horses?
faqs.a: Gold Country Wellness in Loomis offers sessions for pets, and SportsIQ in Westlake Village uses a scanning system built for dogs, cats and horses. Illuminate Vitality in Fresno also lists sessions for animals.

faqs.q: Which towns have massage studios that offer scan sessions?
faqs.a: Massage studios offering scans include Essentials 2 Wellness in Kingsburg, Metamorphosis Health & Massage Therapy in Redding, SKIN AND BEYOND in Fair Oaks and Mind, Body, and Sole Wellness in Citrus Heights. Several of them add reflexology, foot baths or aromatherapy.

faqs.q: Are there California practices that use the SCIO or Eductor device?
faqs.a: Quantum Waves Hypnotherapy & Biofeedback in Los Osos, Beyond Wholeness in Encinitas and Quantum Biofeedback Inc. in Beverly Hills all work with SCIO-type biofeedback devices. Their other services range from hypnotherapy to coaching.

intro: Five bioresonance practitioners work in Canterbury, and most of them are in or around Christchurch. The suburbs of Spreydon and St Albans each have one, the town of Kaiapoi to the north has another, and one practitioner works from the Brilin Centre and also sees clients in Timaru. The mix of practice types is wider than the small number would suggest: a chiropractic and kinesiology clinic, a naturopathic herbalist, a Qigong and tea studio, and practitioners who list bioresonance as their main work.

Infinity Health & Wellness in Spreydon, Christchurch, combines chiropractic and kinesiology with BICOM bioresonance. The team describes an integrative approach built on client education and lifestyle changes, aimed at helping each person reach their best level of wellbeing. It holds a 5.0 rating from 14 Google reviews, every one of them five stars, which is the longest review history on this page.

Naturopathy Inbalance is based in Kaiapoi and serves North Canterbury as well as Christchurch. The practitioner is a naturopath and herbalist who offers personalised herbal formulations, and BICOM bioresonance sessions are part of the range, with each consultation tailored to the client. The rating is 5.0 from 6 reviews.

BICOM is the device named most often in Canterbury, and these two practices are the ones that use it. A different kind of session is offered by Energy Health in St Albans, Christchurch. Gabriela runs it and offers quantum biofeedback alongside Qigong and monthly Cha Dao tea sessions. She trained with the system's inventor, Professor Bill Nelson, in Budapest and attended the QX World Conference. Energy Health is rated 5.0 from 2 reviews.

Remote sessions matter in a region where the main centres are some distance apart. Energy Health offers sessions at a distance, and William Bisset of the Brilin Centre combines in-person bio resonance evaluations for adults and children in Christchurch and Timaru with virtual consultations over Zoom for people elsewhere. He also speaks at corporate and wellness events and runs workshops.
One more Christchurch business, Bioresonance Therapy, is named for the session type. Across the five practices, the reviews add up to 22, and the rating on every one that has reviews is 5.0.

The nearest other page is Auckland. People in Canterbury who want a practitioner outside Christchurch, Kaiapoi or Timaru will find that remote consultations are the route several of these practices have set up.

faqs.q: Who in Canterbury offers BICOM bioresonance sessions?
faqs.a: Two practices use BICOM. Infinity Health & Wellness in Spreydon, Christchurch, pairs it with chiropractic and kinesiology and holds 5.0 from 14 reviews. Naturopathy Inbalance in Kaiapoi offers BICOM sessions within naturopathic and herbal consultations and serves North Canterbury and Christchurch, with 5.0 from 6 reviews.

faqs.q: Can I book a remote session if I live outside Christchurch?
faqs.a: Yes, with some practitioners. William Bisset works with clients in Christchurch and Timaru and offers virtual consultations over Zoom for people elsewhere. Energy Health in St Albans also offers remote sessions. Ask either practice how a session at a distance works before you book.

faqs.q: Which practices in Canterbury offer quantum biofeedback?
faqs.a: Energy Health in St Albans, Christchurch, is the practice that offers quantum biofeedback. Gabriela runs it, and the sessions sit alongside Qigong and monthly Cha Dao tea sessions. It is rated 5.0 from 2 reviews, so the review history is short.

faqs.q: What kinds of practitioners offer scan sessions in Canterbury?
faqs.a: The range is broad. Infinity Health & Wellness combines chiropractic and kinesiology with bioresonance. Naturopathy Inbalance is a naturopath and herbalist. Energy Health pairs biofeedback with Qigong and tea sessions. William Bisset runs bio resonance evaluations from the Brilin Centre and by video.

faqs.q: Is there a practitioner in Timaru?
faqs.a: William Bisset sees clients in Timaru as well as Christchurch, working from the Brilin Centre, and he offers bio resonance evaluations for adults and children. People elsewhere in Canterbury can ask him about virtual consultations over Zoom.

intro: The Pikes Peak area gives the Colorado page of bioresonance practitioners three ZYTO practices that serve overlapping ground. Soulshines Yoga Studio & Healing Arts in Cascade sits at the base of Pikes Peak, ten minutes from Manitou Springs and Woodland Park, and pairs yoga, Pilates and Thai massage with nutritional consultations that use ZYTO scans, rated 5.0 from 47 reviews. Peak Glow in Black Forest offers mobile services across the Pikes Peak Region, with a menu that mixes tanning and makeup with the Raindrop Technique, aromadome sessions and ZYTO, rated 4.8 from 6 reviews. The Herb Doctor in Fountain offers functional health coaching in person and remotely worldwide, rated 5.0 from 16 reviews. The page holds 15 practitioners across the state.

ZYTO is the device of the state, and it appears in the practices of coaches, chiropractors and consultants alike. Acacia Whole Health in Parker is a naturopathic clinic offering frequency sessions, Rife and ZYTO biocommunication, with consultations now provided remotely through ZYTO hand cradles and sessions for animals, rated 5.0 from 24 reviews. Dr. Tamara Boyd, a chiropractor in Frisco, offers ZYTO and is rated 5.0 from 20 reviews. Live Well With Hope in Pagosa Springs is a women-owned wellness consulting practice led by a health and wellness coach and ZYTO practitioner, rated 5.0 from 16 reviews.
